name: showcase-5-next-direction-decide
title: Which direction next — deepen the strongest perturbation contrast (reviewers to choose)
question:
Given the showcase-4 5-variant sweep, which direction should the showcase
take next? The sweep produced a clear ranking — media / growth-condition
change was the strongest, most interpretable contrast; the ppGpp-off
de-repression was the most informative surprise; elong-down was a near-null.
This study stops at a DECISION: it commits no variant. Candidate next
directions are seeded from those results; reviewers pick which one (or more)
to pursue. No simulation runs until a direction is chosen.

report.title: showcase-5 — next-direction decision (no direction committed)
report.objective:
Hand reviewers an explicit, OPEN choice for the NEXT direction, grounded in
the showcase-4 measured contrasts: which follow-up best advances the
showcase? This study deliberately commits no variant (conditions.variants
lists four PROPOSED, uncommitted candidate directions); it presents candidate
directions seeded from the showcase-4 ranking
and stays un-run until a reviewer selects one.
report.result:
[NO RUN — decision study. The sim does not run until a direction is chosen.
The candidate directions below are SEEDED from the showcase-4 results:

  - STRONGEST contrast (media-succinate): dry mass halved, never multiforks
    (oriC 2 vs 4), Toya-2010 flux correlation collapsed 0.727 -> -0.058.
    => candidate A: deepen the growth-condition response (carbon-source panel).
  - MOST INFORMATIVE SURPRISE (ppgpp-off): ppGpp pool ROSE (1.86x) rather
    than collapsing; growth slowed most.
    => candidate B: decompose ppGpp synthesis vs regulation (2x2).
  - PARTIAL (dnaA-2x): advanced re-init timing + dropped Toya r, but did not
    raise the oriC ceiling.
    => candidate C: push the dnaA knob harder / connect to the
       dnaa-replication investigation.
  - NEAR-NULL (elong-down): 0.7x elongation barely moved growth.
    => candidate D: a graded translation-knob dose-response (larger cuts).
]
report.decision:
OPEN — reviewers to choose the next direction. The four candidates (A
growth-condition panel / B ppGpp synthesis-vs-regulation decomposition / C
dnaA knob deepening / D graded translation dose-response) are seeded from the
showcase-4 ranking below. The agent's recommendation is candidate A (deepen
the strongest contrast) with candidate B as the high-information alternative,
but no direction is committed.

decisions_needed.question: Which direction should the showcase take next, given the showcase-4 ranking?
decisions_needed.context:
Four candidate directions seeded from the showcase-4 5-variant sweep. The
agent recommends A (deepen the strongest contrast) or B (chase the most
informative surprise); none is committed.
  A. DEEPEN THE STRONGEST CONTRAST — growth-condition panel. media-succinate
     was the strongest, most interpretable contrast (4 axes at once:
     mass, replication, composition, Toya-flux collapse). Run a small
     panel of carbon sources (glucose / succinate / acetate / glycerol /
     +amino-acids) and chart the growth / flux / composition response.
     FLAG: one full ParCa cache per condition (~2.5 min each).
  B. CHASE THE SURPRISE — ppGpp synthesis vs regulation (2x2). ppgpp-off
     de-repressed rather than collapsed ppGpp (1.86x). Separate ppGpp
     *synthesis* (RelA/SpoT) from the *regulatory* coupling and run a
     synthesis-off / regulation-off 2x2 to pin the mechanism.
  C. PUSH THE PARTIAL — dnaA knob deepening. dnaA-2x advanced re-init
     timing + dropped Toya r but did not raise the oriC ceiling. Sweep the
     dnaA init-probability (1x..4x) and connect to the dnaa-replication
     investigation's replication-initiation readouts.
  D. RESCUE THE NULL — graded translation dose-response. elong-down (0.7x)
     was a near-null; sweep the basal elongation rate across a wider range
     (e.g. 1.0x..0.4x) to find where the steady-state-charging compensation
     breaks and growth actually slows.

report.review_asks:
For reviewers, before any next-direction run:
1. WHICH DIRECTION — A (growth-condition panel), B (ppGpp synthesis-vs-
   regulation 2x2), C (dnaA knob deepening), or D (graded translation
   dose-response)? You may select more than one.
2. READOUT — what is the primary readout you want for the chosen direction
   (growth rate, central-carbon flux / Toya-r, the ppGpp pool, replication
   initiation timing, ...)?
3. COST TRADE-OFF — is the growth-condition panel (A) worth its extra cost
   (one full ParCa cache per condition, ~2.5 min each) vs the single-cache
   directions (B / C / D run on the existing glucose cache)?
4. SCOPE — one direction or a small set?

biological_summary:
This study commits no direction. It frames an explicit reviewer choice among
four follow-ups, each grounded in a measured showcase-4 contrast: deepen the
strongest contrast (a carbon-source panel), chase the most informative surprise
(decompose ppGpp synthesis vs regulation), push the partial (a dnaA
init-probability sweep), or rescue the null (a graded translation
dose-response). The biology of each candidate lives in followup_study_proposals.

literature_anchors.note: The Covert-lab whole-cell model; the wild-type baseline and validation surfaces (Toya-2010 flux, ppGpp, replication) the candidate directions would extend.

model_change:
None yet — the model change is the OPEN decision. Each candidate would alter a
different axis (carbon source + its ParCa cache; ppGpp synthesis vs regulation
decomposition; the dnaA init-probability; or the ribosome elongation rate over
a wider range); see followup_study_proposals.
implementation_requirements:
Single-cache for directions B / C / D (reuse the showcase-1 glucose cache); the
growth-condition panel (A) needs one full ParCa cache per condition (~2.5 min
each) — the cost trade-off flagged for reviewers.

tests.question: Have reviewers selected which next direction to pursue, given the showcase-4 ranking?

measure.detail:
Placeholder decision gate. Resolves when a reviewer picks one (or more) of
the four candidate directions (A growth-condition panel, B ppGpp
synthesis-vs-regulation 2x2, C dnaA knob deepening, D graded translation
dose-response). No quantitative pass/fail — the outcome is the chosen
direction, which then becomes a committed follow-up study.

remaining_uncertainties: Which direction to deepen is an OPEN reviewer choice; no direction is committed in this scaffold.
elong-down's near-null leaves open where (if anywhere) a translation-rate cut starts to slow growth in v2ecoli — candidate D would resolve it.
The ppGpp-off de-repression mechanism (rise, not collapse) is asserted but not decomposed — candidate B would confirm it.

followup_study_proposals.title: A — Growth-condition panel (deepen the strongest contrast)
followup_study_proposals.proposed_experiment:
Run a small panel of carbon sources (glucose / succinate / acetate /
glycerol / +amino-acids), each with its own full ParCa cache, and chart the
growth rate / central-carbon flux (Toya-r) / mass-composition response as a
function of carbon source. Builds directly on media-succinate, the
strongest showcase-4 contrast.

followup_study_proposals.title: B — ppGpp synthesis vs regulation 2x2 (chase the surprise)
followup_study_proposals.proposed_experiment:
Separate ppGpp *synthesis* (RelA/SpoT) from the *regulatory* coupling and
run a synthesis-off / regulation-off 2x2 on the existing glucose cache to
confirm that the showcase-4 ppGpp rise is de-repression. Reads the ppGpp
pool + growth rate per quadrant.

followup_study_proposals.title: C — dnaA init-probability sweep (push the partial)
followup_study_proposals.proposed_experiment:
Sweep the dnaA (TU00259[c]) transcription-init probability across 1x..4x on
the existing glucose cache and connect to the dnaa-replication
investigation's replication-initiation readouts (oriC, critical mass per
oriC). Tests whether a larger knob raises the oriC ceiling that 2x did not.

followup_study_proposals.title: D — graded translation dose-response (rescue the null)
followup_study_proposals.proposed_experiment:
Sweep the ribosome basal elongation rate across a wider range
(e.g. 1.0x..0.4x of 22 aa/s) on the existing glucose cache to find where
the steady-state-charging compensation breaks and growth actually slows —
resolving why the 0.7x elong-down point was a near-null in showcase-4.
